     年度內，本公司一直採用、應用及遵守上市規則                                its corporate value with effective corporate governance procedures. During the

     董事長與首席執行官                                            CHAIRMAN AND CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
     董事會現由四名執行董事、一名非執行董事及四                                The Board currently comprises four executive directors, one non-executive
     名獨立非執行董事組成，具備充分獨立性。年                                 director and four independent non-executive directors and therefore has a fairly
     內，陳序平先生自二零二二年三月一日起擔任首                                strong independence element in its composition. During the year, Mr. Chen
     席執行官，並於二零二二年十月二十八日起擔任                                Xuping was appointed as CEO of the Company on March 1, 2022 and was
     董事會主席。                                               appointed as Chairman of the Board on October 28, 2022.

     於二零二二年十月二十八日委任陳序平先生為董                                Following the appointment of Mr. Chen Xuping as the Chairman of the Board
     事會主席生效後，陳序平先生身兼本公司董事                                 with effect from October 28, 2022, Mr. Chen Xuping assumes the dual roles of
     會主席及首席執行官兩職。是項委任與守則第                                 the Chairman of the Board and the Chief Executive Officer of the Company. This
     C.2.1守則條文有所偏離，其規定主席與行政總                              deviates from code provision C.2.1 of the Code, which requires that the roles
     裁之角色應有區分，並不應由一人同時兼任。於                                of chairman and the chief executive officer should be separate and should not
     評估本集團之發展情況並考慮陳序平先生之經                                 be performed by the same individual. After evaluating the development of the
     驗，董事會認為本公司董事會主席及首席執行官                                Group and taking into account of the experience of Mr. Chen Xuping, the Board

     成結果及外部市場環境的對標，結合董事個人能                                consideration of various factors, such as strategic objectives of the Group, results
     力、績效、崗位價值和對公司的貢獻。薪酬總額                                performance fulfillment and external market conditions as well as directors’
     包括保障工資、津貼、花紅及股權激勵計劃，確                                competence, performance, value of the position and contribution to the Company.
     保長短期激勵的適當結合及維持市場競爭力。                                 The total remuneration includes fixed salary, allowance, bonus and share award
                                                          scheme and ensures an appropriate mixture of long term and short awards as well
                                                          as its competitiveness in the market.

     問責及審核                                                ACCOUNTABILITY AND AUDIT
     董事確認其有責任編製本公司的財務報表所載的                                The Directors acknowledge their responsibilities for preparing all information
     一切資料及陳述，並真實公平地反映本集團財務                                and representations contained in the financial statements of the Company which
     狀況以及期內的業績及現金流量。董事認為財務                                give a true and fair view of the state of affairs of the Group and of the results and
     報表已遵照所有適用會計準則及規定編製，並反                                cash flow for that period. The Directors consider that the financial statements
     映根據董事會及管理層的最佳估計、合理知情及                                have been prepared in conformity with all appropriate accounting standards

風險管理                    RISK MANAGEMENT
有效的風險管理是本集團達致戰略目標的基本及   Effective risk management is the basic and necessary factor for achieving strategic
必要保障，為此本集團已制定《龍湖集團風險管   goals of the Group. As such, the Group has established the Risk Management
理制度》。制度中明確了本集團風險管理組織體   System of Longfor Group, which specifies the Group’s risk management
系及具體職責、風險管理整體流程、風險評估方   organizational system, detailed responsibility, overall procedures of risk
法，以及定期的風險報告機制。          management, risk assessment method and regular risk reporting mechanism.

風險管理組織體系：龍湖集團的風險管理組織體   Risk management organizational system: The risk management organizational
系是董事會領導下的三道基本防線，即公司業務   system of Longfor Group consists of three basic lines of defense under the
職能部門的管理層和員工為第一道防線；由集團   leadership of the Board, namely the management and staff of business
職能負責人組成的，首席執行官為組長、首席財   departments as the first line of defense; the risk management team consisting
務官為副組長的風險管理小組為第二道防線；審   of the general manager of business departments of the Group with the CEO
核委員會、內審部及安全創新部為第三道防線。   as team leader and CFO as deputy team leader as the second line of defense;
董事會是風險管理的最終責任機構，有權對集團   and the Audit Committee, Internal Audit Department, Safe and Innovation
風險管理的政策制度及應對方案進行指引和最終   Management Department as the third line of defense. The Board shall be the
決策，評估集團風險偏好，把握在戰略目標實現   ultimate accountability body of risk management, and shall have the right to
及風險管理之間的匹配度；審核委員會、內審部   provide guidance and make final decisions on the policy, system and responding
及安全創新部由董事會委派，對公司風險管理的   plan of risk management of the Group, conduct assessment on the risk appetite
實施情況進行指導監控，並審閱年度風險管理報   of the Group and control the balance between the realization of strategic goals
告；風險管理小組負責不斷完善風險管理體系，   and risk management. The Audit Committee, Internal Audit Department,
執行包括風險識別、評估、應對方案以及風險管   Safe and Innovation Management Department are authorized by the Board to
理報告的管理流程，包括年度更新風險庫，對應   advise on and monitor the implementation of risk management of the Group

報告。業務部門是風險所有者，對各自的風險領   responsible for the ongoing improvement of risk management system as well as

                   實際利率法為計算金融資產或金融                                   The effective interest method is a method of calculating the
                   負債的攤銷成本及按有關期間攤分                                   amortised cost of a financial asset or financial liability and of
                   利息收入利息開支的方法。實際利                                   allocating interest income and interest expense over the relevant
                   率是將金融資產或金融負債於預計                                   period. The effective interest rate is the rate that exactly discounts
                   年期或（倘適用）較短期間的估計未                                  estimated future cash receipts and payments (including all fees paid

               訂立之對沖工具之公平值變                        portion of gains and losses arising on changes in fair value of

  以權益結算的股份激勵╱購股權                              Equity-settled share award/share option schemes: (Continued)
  計劃：（續）
  (b)   購股權計劃                                 (b)   Share option scheme
        本公司的購股權計劃（「購股權計                             The Company’s share option scheme (the “Share Option Scheme”)
        劃」）乃根據於二零零九年十二月                             was adopted pursuant to a resolution passed on December 23, 2009
        二十三日通過的一項決議案獲採                              for the primary purpose of providing incentives to directors and
        納，主要目的是為本集團董事及合                             eligible employees of the Group. Under the Share Option Scheme,
        資格僱員提供激勵。根據購股權計                             the directors of the Company and its subsidiaries were granted
        劃，本公司及其附屬公司董事已獲                             options to subscribe for shares in the Company. The term of the
        授可認購本公司股份的購股權。購                             Share Option Scheme is 10 years from the date of adoption.

52. 資本風險管理                    52. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT
  本集團管理資本以確保本集團的實體能持                 The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group will
  續經營，同時透過優化債務及股本結餘為                 be able to continue as a going concern while maximising the return to
  股東帶來最大回報。                          shareholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance.

  本集團的資本結構包括債務淨額（包括                  The capital structure of the Group consists of net debt, which includes,
  分別於附註30及31披露的借款及優先票                where appropriate, the borrowings and senior notes disclosed in notes
  據）、現金及現金等價物淨額以及本公司                 30 and 31 respectively, net of cash and cash equivalents and equity
  擁有人應佔權益（包括已發行股本、儲備                 attributable to owners of the Company, comprising issued share capital,
  及保留盈利）。                            reserves and retained earnings.

  本公司董事定期審閱資本架構。作為該審                 The directors of the Company review the capital structure on a regular
  閱的一部分，本公司董事考慮資本成本及                 basis. As part of this review, the directors of the Company consider the
  與各類資本有關的風險，並採取適當措施                 cost of capital and the risks associated with each class of capital, and take
  平衡整體資本架構。                          appropriate actions to balance its overall capital structure.
